parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: The body of the stapler is made of durable plastic and forms the main upper structure of the stapler.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal mechanism that pushes staples through paper when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around a hinge at the rear to press down and staple papers together.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is the top cover of the stapler, typically made of plastic, and provides access to the staple magazine.
parts.Functional_description: It can be lifted to load new staples into the stapler.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates upward around a hinge to open and allow staple refilling.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the bottom part of the stapler, usually made of metal for stability and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a firm surface for the stapling action and holds the anvil that bends the staple legs.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, providing support for the stapling mechanism.
